");--pad:#85ad62;--pad-edge:#d6e5a7}

#battle-arena[data-environment]:not([data-environment=stadium]) .sprite-pad::before{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pad) 84%,transparent);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--pad-edge) 75%,transparent);box-shadow:0 7px 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--pad) 58%,#07111f),0 14px 25px #07111f55}
.arena-location{position:absolute;left:50%;top:12px;z-index:6;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid #ffffff66;background:#07111fc7;color:#f5f7eb;font:800 11px/1 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.09em;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 3px 12px #07111f55;pointer-events:none}

/* v3.3 presentation-only refinement: retain existing game and save logic. */
:root{--line:rgba(192,216,230,.18);--muted:#bbcad7}

.quick-party-card>header{align-items:center}.quick-party-card>header h2{line-height:1.1}

.quick-party-action{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.03em}.party-presets article{border-radius:8px;gap:8px}.party-presets button{border-radius:6px;min-height:38px}
/* Battle feedback stays in its own readable lane, not across combatants. */
.battle-callout{top:auto;bottom:18px;left:50%;translate:-50% 0;width:min(520px,calc(100% - 24px));padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid #f5c542b8;border-left:4px solid var(--yellow);border-radius:9px;background:#071726f5;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0009;text-align:left;pointer-events:none}
.battle-callout strong{font-size:clamp(12px,1.1vw,15px);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.02em}.battle-callout small{font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,13px);line-height:1.4;margin-top:3px}

.hp-track{border:1px solid #8ca3a8;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;padding:0;height:10px}.hp-track i{border-radius:20px}
.move-button,.team-button,.item-button{border-radius:8px}.move-button{min-width:0;gap:8px}.move-name{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.battle-console{border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;overflow:hidden}
.modal-card{border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 24px 90px #000a;max-height:calc(100dvh - 30px);overflow-y:auto}

@media(max-width:800px){.shell{padding-inline:10px}.record{gap:5px 10px}.screen-heading{flex-wrap:wrap}.roster{gap:9px}.rental-card{min-height:238px;padding:12px}.rental-card.selected{padding:11px}.rental-name{max-width:calc(100% - 95px);font-size:.86rem}.rental-meta{max-width:calc(100% - 90px);font-size:.65rem}.rental-xp{width:75px;top:14px;right:12px}.rental-sprite{top:66px;width:43%;height:115px}.type-pills{top:94px;left:12px;max-width:calc(100% - 105px)}.stat-grid{left:7px;right:7px;bottom:8px}.condition-strip{top:44px;width:min(65%,420px)}.battle-callout{bottom:8px;width:min(410px,calc(100% - 16px));padding:8px 10px}.announcer{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3px;padding:9px 12px}.quick-party-owned{max-height:38vh}}
@media(max-width:520px){.roster{grid-template-columns:1fr}.rental-card{min-height:215px}.rental-name{max-width:60%}.rental-meta{max-width:58%}.rental-sprite{top:44px;right:8px;width:38%;height:135px}.type-pills{top:92px;max-width:50%}.stat-grid small{font-size:.56rem}.quick-party-current{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.quick-party-slot{padding:3px}.quick-party-slot>.quick-mon{display:grid;justify-items:center;text-align:center;gap:3px;padding:4px}.quick-party-slot .quick-mon img{width:44px;height:44px}.quick-party-slot .quick-mon strong{font-size:.61rem}.quick-party-remove{font-size:.68rem;min-height:40px}.quick-party-owned .quick-mon{min-height:76px}.battle-callout{bottom:6px}.condition-strip{top:42px;width:70%;justify-content:flex-end}.condition-chip{font-size:9px}.map-marker{min-width:25px;min-height:25px}}

/* Shared mobile design foundation. The app frame has one owner at every width. */
:root {
  --ui-bg:#08101d;--ui-surface-1:#0b1526;--ui-surface-2:#0f1b2e;--ui-surface-3:#15243b;
  --ui-line:#1c2c45;--ui-line-strong:#2d4262;--ui-text:#eef2f8;--ui-muted:#9fb0c8;
  --ui-accent:#f2c14e;--ui-on-accent:#1a1407;--ui-hp:#6fdcaa;--ui-xp:#6aa9ee;--ui-danger:#ff8a7a;
  --ui-gutter:16px;--ui-gap:12px;--ui-group:8px;--ui-radius:14px;--ui-touch:44px;
  --ui-header:56px;--ui-nav:64px;--ui-column:480px;
}
.ui-shell{background:var(--ui-bg);color:var(--ui-text)}
.ui-shell:not(.mobile-battle){height:100dvh;overflow:hidden;padding:0}
.ui-shell:not(.mobile-battle) .shell{width:100%;max-width:none;height:100%;margin:0;padding:0;display:block}
.ui-shell:not(.mobile-battle) .topbar{position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;z-index:25;box-sizing:border-box;height:calc(var(--ui-header) + env(safe-area-inset-top));min-height:0;margin:0;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) var(--ui-gutter) 0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--ui-group);border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-line);background:var(--ui-surface-1);backdrop-filter:none}
.ui-shell .topbar{flex-wrap:nowrap}
.ui-shell .topbar .brand{flex:0 0 30px;width:30px;min-width:30px;gap:0}
.ui-shell .topbar .brand>span:last-child{display:none}
.ui-shell .topbar .brand-mark{transform:scale(.65);transform-origin:left center;margin-right:-16px}
.ui-shell #app-title{flex:1;min-width:0;margin:0;font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.ui-shell .shell-coins{display:flex;gap:5px;align-items:center;min-height:var(--ui-touch);border:0;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ui-surface-3);color:var(--ui-accent);padding:0 8px;font:700 13px/1 inherit;cursor:pointer;max-width:110px;overflow:hidden}
.ui-shell .shell-coins b{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.ui-shell .shell-icon,.ui-shell .topbar .music-button{display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 var(--ui-touch);width:var(--ui-touch);height:var(--ui-touch);min-width:var(--ui-touch);padding:0;border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:10px;background:var(--ui-surface-1);color:var(--ui-text);font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
.ui-shell .topbar .music-button b{display:none}
.ui-shell svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.ui-shell #app-content{position:absolute;top:calc(var(--ui-header) + env(safe-area-inset-top));bottom:calc(var(--ui-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));left:0;right:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:var(--ui-gap) var(--ui-gutter);scroll-padding:var(--ui-gap);box-sizing:border-box}
.ui-shell #app-content>.screen:not(#battle-screen){width:100%;max-width:var(--ui-column);margin:0 auto;padding-bottom:var(--ui-gap)}
.ui-shell #app-content .screen-heading{margin:0 0 var(--ui-gap);gap:var(--ui-group)}
.ui-shell #app-content .screen-heading h1{font-size:22px;line-height:1.2;margin:0 0 var(--ui-group)}
.ui-shell #app-content .screen-heading .eyebrow{font-size:11px;margin:0 0 6px}
.ui-shell #app-content .rules-note{font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
.ui-shell .mode-nav{position:fixed!important;inset:auto 0 0!important;z-index:30;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:0!important;height:calc(var(--ui-nav) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));box-sizing:border-box;margin:0!important;padding:0 max(0px,calc((100vw - var(--ui-column))/2)) env(safe-area-inset-bottom)!important;background:var(--ui-surface-1)!important;border-top:1px solid var(--ui-line);box-shadow:none;overflow:hidden!important}
.ui-shell .mode-nav[hidden]{display:none!important}
.ui-shell .mode-nav .nav-button{height:var(--ui-nav);min-height:var(--ui-touch)!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0;padding:6px 0!important;border:0!important;border-top:3px solid transparent!important;border-radius:0;background:var(--ui-surface-1)!important;color:var(--ui-muted)!important;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px!important}
.ui-shell .mode-nav .nav-button span{font-size:11px;line-height:1.2}
.ui-shell .mode-nav .nav-button.active{color:var(--ui-accent)!important;border-top-color:var(--ui-accent)!important}
.ui-shell #cups-screen #party-tray{position:static!important;top:auto!important;margin:0 0 var(--ui-gap)!important;padding:6px;grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr)!important;background:var(--ui-surface-2);border:1px solid var(--ui-line);border-radius:var(--ui-radius)}
.ui-shell #party-tray .party-tray-label{min-width:0;padding:0}
.ui-shell #party-tray .party-tray-label span,.ui-shell #party-tray .party-tray-label small{display:none}
.ui-shell #party-tray .party-tray-team{gap:4px;grid-template-columns:repeat(var(--party-slots,3),minmax(0,1fr))}
.ui-shell #party-tray .tray-mon{min-height:var(--ui-touch);min-width:0;padding:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px}
.ui-shell #party-tray .tray-mon img{width:32px!important;height:32px!important}
.ui-shell #party-tray .tray-mon span{display:none}
.ui-shell #shell-menu{width:min(440px,calc(100% - 24px));max-height:calc(100dvh - 40px);box-sizing:border-box;overflow:auto;background:var(--ui-surface-2);color:var(--ui-text);border:1px solid var(--ui-line-strong);border-radius:22px;padding:var(--ui-gutter)}
.ui-shell #shell-menu::backdrop{background:rgb(0 0 0 / .72)}
.ui-shell #shell-menu>header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--ui-group);margin-bottom:var(--ui-gap)}
.ui-shell #shell-menu h2{font-size:22px;margin:0}
.ui-shell .shell-menu-actions{display:grid;gap:var(--ui-group)}
.ui-shell #shell-menu .secondary-button{display:block;min-height:var(--ui-touch);box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;margin:0;text-align:left;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:0;border-radius:10px}
.ui-shell #shell-menu #save-tools{display:block!important;margin-top:var(--ui-gap);font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}
.ui-shell #shell-menu #save-tools summary{min-height:var(--ui-touch);padding:var(--ui-group);box-sizing:border-box;cursor:pointer}
.ui-shell #shell-menu .save-actions{display:grid;gap:var(--ui-group)}
.ui-shell #shell-menu .save-actions a{min-height:var(--ui-touch);color:var(--ui-accent)}
.ui-shell #shell-menu #reset-save{display:block;min-height:var(--ui-touch);margin-top:var(--ui-gap);color:var(--ui-danger)}
.ui-shell .shell-icon.save-warning{color:var(--ui-danger);border-color:var(--ui-danger)}
.ui-shell button:focus-visible,.ui-shell a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ui-accent);outline-offset:2px}
.ui-shell.mobile-battle #app-content{position:static;padding:0;overflow:visible}
.ui-shell.mobile-battle .topbar,.ui-shell.mobile-battle #mode-nav{display:none!important}
@media(min-width:801px){.ui-shell.mobile-battle{overflow:auto}.ui-shell.mobile-battle #battle-screen{max-width:1000px;margin:auto}}
@media(max-width:359px){:root{--ui-gutter:12px}.ui-shell:not(.mobile-battle) .topbar{gap:4px}.ui-shell #app-title{font-size:18px}.ui-shell .shell-coins{max-width:82px;font-size:12px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ui-shell dialog,.ui-shell .nav-button{transition:none;animation:none}}

</style>
    <style>
/* Battle owns three zones: information/arena, message, and commands. */
.ui-shell.mobile-battle{height:100dvh;overflow:hidden}
.ui-shell.mobile-battle #battle-screen{--console-height:334px;position:fixed;inset:0;margin:0 auto;width:min(100%,480px);max-width:480px;height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;box-sizing:border-box;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) var(--console-height);gap:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ui-bg)}
.ui-shell.mobile-battle #battle-screen[data-duo=true]{--console-height:416px;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) var(--console-height)}
.ui-shell .battle-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:3px;padding:6px 12px;background:var(--ui-surface-1);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-line);min-width:0}
.ui-shell .battle-top .match-strip{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:auto;min-height:20px;margin:0;padding:0;background:none;color:var(--ui-text);font-size:11px;border:0;letter-spacing:.03em}
.ui-shell .battle-top #match-type{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.ui-shell .battle-top #turn-count{flex-shrink:0;color:var(--ui-accent)}

    <style>
/* v4.3 battle flow: the arena is for action; the lower dialogue owns information. */
#battle-screen .announcer{position:relative;min-height:70px;padding:12px 16px 13px 18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#102c49,#091b30);border-top:3px solid #f5c542;overflow:hidden}
#battle-screen .announcer-label{display:none}
#battle-screen #message{margin:0;min-height:26px;color:#f7fbff;font-size:17px;line-height:1.35;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.01em}
#battle-screen #message .battle-speaker{color:#f5c542}
.battle-cues{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;min-height:24px;margin-top:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.battle-cue{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:22px;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid #ffffff35;border-radius:999px;background:#ffffff10;color:#e9f4fb;font-size:11px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:cue-in .18s ease-out}
.battle-cue[data-tone=super]{background:#1f694a;border-color:#78e8ae;color:#eafff2}.battle-cue[data-tone=resist]{background:#354458;color:#9fb5c6}.battle-cue[data-tone=critical]{background:#7c341e;border-color:#ff9b62;color:#fff1df}.battle-cue[data-tone=miss]{background:#3a4657;color:#dce8f2}.battle-cue[data-tone=status]{background:#5b3975;border-color:#b98add}.battle-cue[data-tone=immune]{background:#3b4050;color:#fff}.battle-cue[data-tone=ko]{background:#7b2331;border-color:#ff8295;color:#fff}
#battle-screen .hp-track i{transition:width .52s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1),background-color .25s ease}
#battle-screen[data-phase=anticipation] .battle-world{filter:saturate(.92)}
#battle-screen[data-phase=impact] .battle-world{filter:saturate(1.12)}
#battle-screen[data-phase=recovery] .battle-world{transition-duration:280ms}
@keyframes cue-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:700px){#battle-screen .announcer{min-height:62px;padding:8px 10px 9px;border-top-width:2px}#battle-screen #message{font-size:14px;line-height:18px;min-height:18px}.battle-cues{min-height:20px;margin-top:3px;gap:4px}.battle-cue{min-height:19px;padding:1px 6px;font-size:9px}.battle-history{display:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.battle-cue{animation:none}#battle-screen .hp-track i{transition:none}}

</style>
    <style>
/* v4.4 choreography: arena carries the move; text stays out of its way. */
#battle-arena{isolation:isolate;transition:filter .18s ease,background .2s ease}
#battle-arena::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:18;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .16s ease;background:transparent}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="storm"]{filter:brightness(.72) saturate(.92)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="storm"]::after{opacity:.38;background:radial-gradient(circle at 68% 38%,rgba(255,245,170,.24),transparent 26%),linear-gradient(rgba(7,13,38,.44),rgba(7,13,38,.18))}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="psychic"]{filter:saturate(1.22) hue-rotate(12deg)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="psychic"]::after{opacity:.42;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(236,108,255,.28),transparent 55%)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="spectral"]{filter:brightness(.78) saturate(.72) hue-rotate(28deg)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="spectral"]::after{opacity:.38;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 62% 45%,rgba(85,39,128,.42),transparent 58%)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="frost"]{filter:brightness(.94) saturate(.8)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="frost"]::after{opacity:.34;background:linear-gradient(rgba(190,246,255,.18),rgba(90,190,230,.12))}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="heat"]{filter:saturate(1.18) contrast(1.04)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="heat"]::after{opacity:.3;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 55%,rgba(255,108,42,.3),transparent 48%)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="flood"]::after{opacity:.36;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(41,173,235,.34),transparent 58%)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="quake"]{animation:v44-quake .11s linear 3}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="beam"]{filter:brightness(.82) contrast(1.08)}
#battle-arena[data-move-scene="beam"]::after{opacity:.3;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,rgba(255,248,190,.36),transparent 44%)}
@keyframes v44-quake{0%,100%{transform:translate(0)}25%{transform:translate(-2px,1px)}75%{transform:translate(2px,-1px)}}
.classic-fx-punctuation{position:absolute;z-index:26;left:50%;top:48%;width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.45);filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28));pointer-events:none;animation:v44-pop .38s cubic-bezier(.15,.75,.25,1) both}
@keyframes v44-pop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.25) rotate(-12deg)}22%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.25) rotate(3deg)}68%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.95)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.18)}}
#battle-arena[data-move-family="contact"] .attack-canvas{filter:contrast(1.08)}
#battle-arena[data-move-family="electric"] .attack-canvas{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,241,119,.75))}
#battle-arena[data-move-family="ice"] .attack-canvas{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(188,245,255,.65))}
#battle-arena[data-move-family="fire"] .attack-canvas{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,112,47,.55))}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#battle-arena[data-move-scene]{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.classic-fx-punctuation{display:none}}

</style>
<style>
/* v4.6 battle refinement: arena is visual; dialogue rail owns routine battle text. */
#battle-screen .move-banner,#battle-screen .impact-label{display:none!important}
#battle-screen .battle-callout{display:none!important}
#battle-screen .announcer{z-index:20}
#battle-screen .battle-cues{margin-top:4px}

/* Trainer encounters: compact DS/anime-inspired face-off rather than a document card. */
.trainer-scene{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 35%,#243a55 0,#081321 58%,#030914 100%)}
.trainer-scene .scene-card{position:relative;width:min(760px,96vw);padding:0;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #eaf1e5;background:#07111f;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 18px 60px #000c}
.trainer-scene .scene-card>.eyebrow{margin:0;padding:12px 18px 5px;color:#aebdca;font:800 12px/1.2 monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;background:#07111f}
.trainer-scene .scene-card>h2{margin:0;padding:0 18px 13px;color:#fff;font-size:clamp(21px,4vw,32px);font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;background:#07111f}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:270px;gap:0;background:linear-gradient(118deg,#d8b640 0 48.5%,#07111f 48.7% 51.3%,#3f6d9a 51.5% 100%);isolation:isolate}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage:before{content:"VS";position:absolute;z-index:6;left:50%;top:50%;translate:-50% -50%;display:grid;place-items:center;width:62px;height:62px;border:4px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;background:#07111f;color:#f5c542;font:1000 23px/1 Arial;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #0008}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 46%,#fff2 46% 46.5%,transparent 47% 53%,#fff2 53.5% 54%,transparent 54%);z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage>img{position:relative;z-index:3;width:100%;height:230px;padding:20px 8%;box-sizing:border-box;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;animation:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 0 #0004)}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage>#scene-player{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;transform:scaleX(-1)}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage>#scene-trainer{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}
.trainer-scene .scene-versus-name{position:absolute;z-index:5;bottom:12px;padding:6px 10px;background:#07111fd9;border:1px solid #ffffff55;font:900 11px/1 monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#fff}
.trainer-scene .scene-versus-name.player{left:12px}.trainer-scene .scene-versus-name.foe{right:12px}
.trainer-scene .scene-team-pips{position:absolute;z-index:5;top:12px;display:flex;gap:4px}.trainer-scene .scene-team-pips.player{left:12px}.trainer-scene .scene-team-pips.foe{right:12px}
.trainer-scene .scene-team-pips i{width:12px;height:12px;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%,#fff 0 35%,#15283b 37% 49%,#e44949 51% 100%);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #0008}
.trainer-scene .scene-stage .kanto-badge{position:absolute;z-index:7;left:50%;top:50%;translate:-50% -50%;margin:0;transform:scale(2.2);animation:badge-award .65s ease-out}
.trainer-scene .scene-dialogue{margin:0;padding:12px 14px 14px;border:0;border-top:2px solid #f5c542;background:#0d2843;color:#fff}
.trainer-scene .scene-dialogue>p{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:clamp(14px,2.4vw,17px);line-height:1.35}
.trainer-scene .encounter-plan{display:none!important}
.trainer-scene .scene-dialogue button{min-height:48px;border-color:#f5c542;background:#f5c542;color:#101a25}
.trainer-scene[data-phase=win] .scene-stage,.trainer-scene[data-phase=loss] .scene-stage{grid-template-columns:1fr;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#19324b,#0a1725)}
.trainer-scene[data-phase=win] .scene-stage>#scene-player,.trainer-scene[data-phase=loss] .scene-stage>#scene-player,.trainer-scene[data-phase=win] .scene-stage:before,.trainer-scene[data-phase=loss] .scene-stage:before{display:none}
.trainer-scene[data-phase=win] .scene-stage>#scene-trainer,.trainer-scene[data-phase=loss] .scene-stage>#scene-trainer{grid-column:1;justify-self:center;width:55%}
@media(max-width:600px){.trainer-scene .scene-card{width:94vw}.trainer-scene .scene-stage{min-height:220px}.trainer-scene .scene-stage>img{height:200px;padding:22px 4%}.trainer-scene .scene-stage:before{width:48px;height:48px;font-size:18px}.trainer-scene .scene-card>.eyebrow{padding:10px 12px 4px}.trainer-scene .scene-card>h2{padding:0 12px 10px}.trainer-scene .scene-dialogue{padding:10px 12px 12px}}

/* Only exceptional battle-state words may occupy the arena. */
.battle-action-word{position:absolute;z-index:60;left:50%;top:42%;translate:-50% -50%;padding:8px 14px;border:2px solid #fff;background:#07111fe8;color:#fff;font:950 clamp(16px,4vw,27px)/1 Arial;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;animation:v46-action-word .72s ease-out both}
@keyframes v46-action-word{0%{opacity:0;scale:.82}18%{opacity:1;scale:1.08}35%{scale:1}78%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;translate:-50% -68%}}

</style>
<style>
/* v4.7 — Gen III-inspired Poké Ball presentation. Source assets from supplied FireRed decomp. */
.capture-ball,.sendout-ball{
  border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background-color:transparent!important;
  background-repeat:no-repeat!important;background-position:0 0!important;
  background-size:32px 96px!important;width:32px!important;height:32px!important;
  box-shadow:none!important;color:transparent!important;image-rendering:pixelated;
  transform-origin:50% 78%;overflow:visible;
}
.capture-ball[data-ball="pokeBall"],.sendout-ball{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,")!important}
.capture-ball[data-ball="greatBall"]{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,")!important}
.capture-ball[data-ball="ultraBall"]{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,")!important}
.capture-ball[data-ball="masterBall"]{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,")!important}
.capture-ball[data-ball="safariBall"]{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,")!important}
.capture-ball[data-ball="premierBall"]{background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,")!important}
.capture-ball.ball-open{background-position:0 -32px!important}
.capture-ball::before,.capture-ball::after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;opacity:0}
.capture-ball.ball-open::before{inset:-20px;border-radius:50%;opacity:1;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0 5%,#9ce8ff 6% 13%,transparent 35%);animation:ball-flash .22s ease-out both}
.capture-ball.ball-open::after{left:50%;top:50%;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;opacity:1;box-shadow:-20px -8px 0 #fff,20px -12px 0 #fff,-16px 15px 0 #9ce8ff,18px 13px 0 #fff,0 -22px 0 #fff;animation:ball-sparks .32s ease-out both}
.capture-ball.ball-landed{filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 2px #07111f66)}
.capture-ball.caught{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px #ffe66a) drop-shadow(0 4px 2px #07111f66)!important}
.capture-ball.caught::after{opacity:1;left:50%;top:50%;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff7a8;box-shadow:-14px -10px 0 #fff7a8,15px -8px 0 #fff,0 -19px 0 #fff7a8;animation:caught-stars .55s ease-out both}
.capture-ball.escaped{filter:brightness(1.25) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #d8f6ff)!important}
@keyframes ball-flash{from{transform:scale(.2);opacity:1}to{transform:scale(1.3);opacity:0}}
@keyframes ball-sparks{from{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.3) rotate(0);opacity:1}to{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.5) rotate(35deg);opacity:0}}
@keyframes caught-stars{0%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.3);opacity:0}35%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.5);opacity:0}}

</style>
<style>
.item-icon.source-backed,.item-glyph.source-backed,.reward-icon.source-backed{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;padding:0!important;overflow:visible!important}
.source-item-img{width:48px;height:48px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.22))}

<style>
/* v5.0 Journey Board — landscape RPG overworld */
#cups-screen .screen-heading{margin-bottom:8px}.map-help{margin:0 0 10px;color:#b8c8d8;font-size:13px}
.kanto-scroll{position:relative;padding:8px!important;border:2px solid #789b86!important;border-radius:14px!important;background:#142333!important;overflow:hidden!important;box-shadow:0 14px 34px #02081299!important}
.kanto-map{position:relative!important;width:100%!important;aspect-ratio:16/9!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:min(58vh,560px);border-radius:9px!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#315c54!important}
.kanto-map>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:center 48%!important;filter:saturate(.82) brightness(.76) contrast(1.08)!important;transform:scale(1.03)}
.kanto-map:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0a203522 0%,#07111c08 50%,#07111c66 100%),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,transparent 35%,#06101a55 100%)}
.journey-route{z-index:2!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 1px #0b1726)}.journey-route polyline{stroke:#fff0a8!important;stroke-width:.65!important;stroke-dasharray:1.4 1.05!important;opacity:.95!important;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.map-marker{z-index:4!important;width:clamp(34px,5.4vw,54px)!important;height:clamp(34px,5.4vw,54px)!important;border-radius:50%!important;border:3px solid #f8f3d4!important;background:#203448!important;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #08131f,0 0 0 3px #fff7c744!important;display:grid!important;place-items:center!important;transition:transform .16s ease,filter .16s ease!important}
.map-marker .kanto-badge{width:84%!important;height:84%!important}.map-marker.completed{background:#e9f3df!important;border-color:#fff!important}.map-marker.current{background:#f6c94d!important;animation:v50pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite}.map-marker.locked{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.55);opacity:.72;cursor:not-allowed}.map-marker[aria-pressed=true]{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.16)!important;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #08131f,0 0 0 5px #f6c94d88!important}.map-marker.locked[aria-pressed=true]{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)!important}
@keyframes v50pulse{50%{box-shadow:0 4px 0 #08131f,0 0 0 8px #f6c94d22}}
.journey-avatar{z-index:6!important;width:clamp(28px,5vw,46px)!important;height:clamp(32px,5.8vw,54px)!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;transform:translate(-50%,-112%)!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 1px #06101bcc);transition:left .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),top .65s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)!important}
.journey-avatar img{display:none}.journey-avatar:before{content:"";width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background:url("data:image/png;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;image-rendering:pixelated;transform:scale(1.55)}
.v50-city-label{position:absolute;z-index:3;transform:translate(-50%,calc(-50% + 31px));font:800 clamp(8px,1.3vw,11px)/1 system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 3px #07111c,0 0 5px #07111c;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}.v50-city-label.locked{opacity:.45}
.map-legend{margin:9px 2px 12px!important;font-size:11px!important}.map-stop{position:relative!important;overflow:hidden;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(92px,150px) 1fr auto!important;gap:18px!important;align-items:center!important;padding:18px!important;min-height:150px;border:1px solid #607c8d!important;border-left:5px solid var(--gym-accent,#f6c94d)!important;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#102437 0%,#102437 55%,var(--gym-wash,#263f4a) 140%)!important;isolation:isolate}
.map-stop:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:8%;top:50%;width:92px;height:92px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:url("data:image/png;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;image-rendering:pixelated;opacity:.08;z-index:-1}.map-stop>.v50-leader{width:100%;height:124px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 0 #06111b66);align-self:end}.map-stop h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,38px);letter-spacing:-.02em}.v50-gym-kicker{margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--gym-accent,#f6c94d);font:900 11px/1.2 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.12em}.v50-gym-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:10px 0}.v50-chip{padding:5px 8px;border:1px solid #ffffff25;border-radius:5px;background:#07172599;color:#dce8ee;font:800 10px/1 ui-monospace,monospace}.map-stop .stop-note{margin:7px 0 0!important;color:#b8cad5!important}.map-stop .primary-button{min-width:170px}.v50-team{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:11px}.v50-mon{width:38px;height:38px;padding:3px;border:1px solid #ffffff33;border-radius:50%;background:#071725;image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:contain}
@media(max-width:700px){.kanto-scroll{margin-left:-12px;margin-right:-12px;border-radius:0!important;padding:4px!important}.kanto-map{aspect-ratio:16/10!important}.v50-city-label{display:none}.map-stop{grid-template-columns:82px 1fr!important;gap:12px!important;padding:14px!important}.map-stop>.v50-leader{height:105px}.map-stop .primary-button{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%}.map-stop h2{font-size:25px}.v50-team{display:none}.map-legend{justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:8px!important}.map-marker{width:34px!important;height:34px!important;border-width:2px!important}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.map-marker.current{animation:none}.journey-avatar{transition:none!important}}

</style>
<style>
.v51-fx-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:31;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}.v51-source-fx{position:absolute;width:54px;height:54px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.35));pointer-events:none}.v51-source-fx.secondary{width:44px;height:44px}.v51-source-fx.travel{width:46px;height:46px}.v51-source-fx.status,.v51-source-fx.reaction{width:48px;height:48px}.v51-source-fx.ground{width:62px;height:62px}.v51-hide-procedural .attack-canvas{opacity:0!important}#battle-arena[data-v51-kind="beam"] .v51-source-fx{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(255,244,165,.9))}#battle-arena[data-v51-kind="special"] .v51-source-fx{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,.45))}.cinematic-layer[data-scene="critical"] .cinematic-flash{opacity:1!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 100vmax rgba(255,255,255,.16)}#battle-arena[data-cinematic^="critical"]{animation:v51-critical-kick .1s linear 2}@keyframes v51-critical-kick{0%,100%{transform:translate(0)}25%{transform:translate(-3px,1px)}75%{transform:translate(3px,-1px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.v51-source-fx{animation:none!important}.v51-fx-layer{display:none}}

</style>
<style>
.save-reset-setting{max-width:620px;margin-top:18px;padding:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;background:#221a24;border:1px solid #85545f;border-radius:12px}.save-reset-setting div{display:grid;gap:6px}.save-reset-setting strong{letter-spacing:.08em}.save-reset-setting small{color:#c9b9bd;line-height:1.45}.save-reset-setting button{min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #d96b76;background:#51232b;color:#fff;font-weight:900;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap}@media(max-width:600px){.save-reset-setting{align-items:stretch;flex-direction:column}.save-reset-setting button{width:100%}}

</style>
<style>
/* v5.5 move-by-move battle presentation */
.v55-signature-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:19;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.v55-beam{position:absolute;height:8px;transform-origin:0 50%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff8,white 30%,#fff4a8 62%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 8px #fff,0 0 22px #fff3a6,0 0 42px #ffe25f}
.v55-ring{position:absolute;width:36px;height:36px;border:3px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 14px #fff;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.v55-wave{position:absolute;width:150%;height:46%;left:-25%;bottom:-10%;border-radius:50% 50% 0 0;background:linear-gradient(#bdf6ffcc,#4bbde8cc 45%,#1768a6dd);box-shadow:0 -8px 25px #9defff88}
.v55-psychic{position:absolute;width:130px;height:130px;border:5px double #e5b8ff;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 20px #b74cff, inset 0 0 25px #7d2cff;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.v55-ground-crack{position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;bottom:12%;height:6px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#d7a05a,#fff2b3,#d7a05a,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 14px #d7a05a;transform:skewX(-28deg)}
.v55-heal{position:absolute;font:900 26px/1 monospace;color:#d9fff0;text-shadow:0 0 8px #54ffc0,0 0 18px #21c984;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.v55-charge{position:absolute;width:110px;height:110px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 0 8%,#fff7a4 9% 18%,#ffe55c66 28%,transparent 68%);transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.arena.v55-heavy-hit{animation:v55-heavy .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.arena.v55-critical-hit{animation:v55-critical .58s cubic-bezier(.15,.9,.2,1)}
@keyframes v55-heavy{20%{translate:-3px 1px}40%{translate:4px -2px}65%{translate:-2px 2px}}
@keyframes v55-critical{15%{translate:-6px 2px;filter:brightness(1.5)}30%{translate:7px -4px}48%{translate:-5px -1px}68%{translate:3px 3px}100%{translate:0;filter:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.arena.v55-heavy-hit,.arena.v55-critical-hit{animation:none!important}}

</style>

  <body>
  <noscript><div style="margin:16px;padding:16px;border:1px solid #8fa7ba;background:#102235;color:#fff;font:600 16px/1.4 system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif">Yellow Stadium needs JavaScript to run. This file preview cannot play the game. Open the hosted HTTPS game link in Safari instead.</div></noscript>
    <main class="shell">
      <header class="topbar">
        <div class="brand" aria-label="Yellow Stadium">
          <span class="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true"></span>
          <span>YELLOW <b>STADIUM</b></span>
        </div>
        <div class="record" aria-label="Player record">
          <span class="coin-bank"><i aria-hidden="true">●</i><b id="coins">0</b> COINS</span>
          <span><b id="collection-count">0</b> / 151</span>
          <span><b id="wins">0</b> WINS</span>
          <span><b id="streak">0</b> STREAK</span>
          <span class="trainer-identity"><b id="trainer-name">ROOKIE</b> TRAINER</span>
          <button id="music-toggle" class="music-button" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Mute music">
            <span aria-hidden="true">♪</span><b>MUSIC ON</b>
          </button>
          <button id="reset-save" class="text-button" type="button">RESET SAVE</button>
        </div>
      </header>
      <details class="save-tools" id="save-tools">
        <summary>PROGRESS · <span id="save-status" role="status">Starting…</span></summary>
        <p>Progress saves in this browser on this device. Use the same browser and game link each time. Export a backup before switching browsers or clearing website data.</p>
        <div class="save-actions">
          <button id="save-now" type="button" class="secondary-button">SAVE NOW</button>
          <button id="export-save" type="button" class="secondary-button">EXPORT BACKUP</button>
          <label class="secondary-button">RESTORE BACKUP <input id="import-save" type="file" accept=".json,application/json"></label>
          <a href="https://yellow-stadium.alexander-jeffrey-si.chatgpt.site" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open game directly ↗</a>
        </div>
        <p id="save-help" aria-live="polite"></p>
      </details>

      <nav id="mode-nav" class="mode-nav" aria-label="Game areas" hidden>
        <button id="collection-tab" class="nav-button active" type="button">POKÉMON BOX</button>
        <button id="cups-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">JOURNEY</button>
        <button id="trainer-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">CUPS</button>
        <button id="safari-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">SAFARI</button>
        <button id="pokedex-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">POKÉDEX</button>
        <button id="shop-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">POKÉ MART</button><button id="bag-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">BAG</button><button id="settings-tab" class="nav-button" type="button">SETTINGS</button>
        <button id="joke-guide" class="nav-button guide-button" type="button">PROF. JOKE</button>
      </nav>

      <section id="onboarding-screen" class="screen onboarding-screen" hidden>
        <div id="partner-step">
          <p class="eyebrow">BEGIN YOUR JOURNEY</p>
          <h1>Choose your partner.</h1>
          <p class="onboarding-copy">Professor Joke has offered you one Pokémon. Choose carefully—then investigate the two eggs rustling in your bag.</p>
          <div id="starter-grid" class="starter-grid"></div>
        </div>
        <div id="egg-step" hidden>
          <p class="eyebrow">SOMETHING IS RUSTLING IN YOUR BAG</p>
          <h1>Your eggs are hatching.</h1>
          <p class="onboarding-copy">Tap each egg to discover two different, unevolved Pokémon from the original 151.</p>
          <div id="egg-grid" class="egg-grid"></div>
          <button id="begin-journey" class="primary-button" type="button" disabled>OPEN PARTY <span>›</span></button>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="select-screen" class="screen select-screen" hidden>
        <div class="screen-heading">
          <div>
            <p class="eyebrow">YOUR PARTY</p>
            <h1>Build your team.</h1>
            <p class="rules-note">Your Pokémon Box: tap MANAGE PARTY to add, remove, or load a saved team. Tap a Pokémon to view its details.</p><button id="box-manage-party" class="primary-button" type="button">MANAGE PARTY · ADD / REMOVE / PRESETS ›</button>
          </div>
          <div class="team-builder-controls">
            <span>PARTY CAPACITY</span>
            <div><button id="team-size-3" type="button" hidden>3</button><button id="team-size-6" class="active" type="button">6</button></div>
            <div class="selection-readout"><span id="pick-count">0</span> / <b id="pick-limit">6</b></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div id="roster" class="roster" aria-label="Party Pokémon"></div>
        <details id="party-workshop" class="workshop"><summary>TRAINING · MOVES & HELD ITEMS</summary><div id="training-content"></div></details>
        <div class="selection-footer">
          <div id="selection-note" class="selection-note">Build an adventure party of up to six Pokémon. Kanto Cups use a temporary three-Pokémon roster.</div>
          <div class="mode-actions">
            <button id="start-safari" class="secondary-button" type="button" disabled>SAFARI FIELD</button>
            <button id="start-battle" class="primary-button" type="button" disabled>ENTER CUP ARCADE <span aria-hidden="true">›</span></button>
            <button id="start-duo" class="primary-button" type="button" disabled hidden>DOUBLES <span aria-hidden="true">›</span></button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section id="settings-screen" class="screen" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">PLAYER OPTIONS</p><h1>Settings.</h1></div></div><label class="exp-setting"><input id="shared-exp" type="checkbox" checked><span><strong>SHARED EXP</strong><small>When on, your whole battle team earns experience. When off, only Pokémon that entered the field earn experience.</small></span></label></section>

      <section id="cups-screen" class="screen cups-screen" hidden>
        <div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">KANTO JOURNEY</p><h1>Travel the region. Earn all eight badges.</h1><p id="cup-summary" class="rules-note"></p></div><div id="badge-count" class="selection-readout"><span>0</span> / 8</div></div>
